title: The Empty Tank
scene: At 2:05 PM, the aquarium rare fish vanished. The pump room was sealed during maintenance from 1:50 to 2:20.

suspects.name: Marco Hale
suspects.testimony: I was giving a tour at 2:05 in the main hall.
suspects.alibiProof: The tour tickets show Marco's badge at 2:02 and 2:12.

suspects.name: Nadia Cruz
suspects.testimony: I was in the viewing tunnel at 2:05, cleaning glass.
suspects.alibiProof: The tunnel camera shows Nadia's tank suit at 2:04.

suspects.name: Omar Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was in the pump room at 2:05, checking the seal.
suspects.contradiction: The pump room was sealed from outside, and algae slime marked Omar's sleeves.

suspects.name: Petra Lund
suspects.testimony: I was at the entrance desk at 2:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk log shows Petra stamping tickets at 2:03 and 2:09.
